prompt: Artificial intelligence (AI) will replace most human jobs in the future. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
It is often argued that human employees will be replaced by artificial intelligence in the future. I completely agree with this statement because AI is developing day by day and is able to analyse massive amounts of information at one moment. Also, AI has greater speed and productivity than human workers.

One major reason is that AI has greater speed and productivity compared to human employees. This is because, in difficult situations or complex tasks, AI can find solutions within several seconds. It can also speed up the process of completing tasks and analyse information quickly. For example, in marketing, people may spend one hour creating invitations, whereas AI can complete this task in a few seconds, saving a significant amount of time. Additionally, people may spend one or two hours creating presentations using PowerPoint, but an AI tool called Gamma can create professional and creative presentations within several seconds. Therefore, difficult tasks and situations can be completed more easily and immediately with the help of AI.

Another important reason is that many people prefer better time management and cheaper educational activities. AI programmes can help people study foreign languages, marketing, and different types of courses. This is very convenient because people can receive education while staying at home, and it is often cheaper than attending traditional courses. Moreover, AI can provide personalised lessons according to a person's level and needs. For instance, students can ask AI to explain difficult topics, correct their mistakes, or create exercises for them. As a result, AI can make education more accessible, flexible, and affordable for a large number of people. In the future, this may reduce the demand for some teachers and other employees whose work can be performed by AI systems.

In conclusion, I strongly agree that artificial intelligence will replace many human employees in the future. Its high speed, productivity, ability to analyse large amounts of information, and affordable educational opportunities make it more efficient in many areas. Although some jobs will continue to require human skills and creativity, the development of AI is likely to reduce the need for human workers in many professions.
